item.title: LOST SOCIETY Announce European / UK Tour Dates For March 2026
item.description: Kicking off in March 2026, right after the release of their new album, Hell Is A State Of Mind, Lost Society will embark on a European tour, hitting cities throughout the UK, Germany, Netherlands, Switzerland and Scandinavia. Fans can expect a high-voltage set packed with fan favourites, ferocious riffs, and the band’s unmistakable adrenaline-charged energy.
